[ S. dātṛ], one who gives, a giver (+ gen. or acc.) ; D I 89, 10 (ahaṃ … mantānaṃ ~ā tvaṃ mantānaṃ paṭiggahetā ti); M I 111, 14 (atthassa ninnetā amatassa ~ā dhammassāmī tathāgato); S III 251, 11 (~ā hoti mūlagandhānaṃ); A II 203, 18 (sā na ~ā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ …); Sn 713 (appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya ~āraṃ nāvajāniya); Ja IV 42, 9* (tvaṃ no s’ issariyaṃ ~ā); VI 298, 7* (sabbakāmānaṃ ~āraṃ); Th-a I 145, 22 (atthi pana koci nāgarānaṃ dāne ekadivasaṃ sahassaṃ ~ā ti); Pañca-g 50 (~āro); — adāta(r) , m. , one who does not give ; Pv 20:2 (~ā); Ja V 382, 22 (ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pubbe … maccharī tiṇaggena telabinduṃ pi ~ā ahosi, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se telabindussāpi).
ādāta(r) m. [ from ādiyati 1 ; cf S. ādātṛ], one who takes, who receives ; M I 286, 18 (adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ~ā hoti) ≠ A V 264, 16 .
CPD: ādāta(r) , m. [ sa. ādātṛ], one who takes; nom. sg. adinnaṃ theyyasaṃkhātaṃ (na) ~ā hoti, M l 286, 18 ; 287, 32 ; lll 46, 28 ; 47, 10 - A V 264, 16 ; 283, 8 ; 284, 21 ; 295, 9 . ādātar
